name: Medicine shortages
value: 7 UK SSPs active; record price concessions
summary: Seven UK Serious Shortage Protocols active into January; pharmacists say shortages hit up to 6.4m items a month
state: NHSBSA's list checked on 19 Nov shows seven active Serious Shortage Protocols, for lansoprazole orodispersible tablets to 15 Jan 2027 and Estradot patches and Creon 25000 capsules to 8 Jan 2027, with none issued since September (NHSBSA). On 17 Nov the National Pharmacy Association estimated shortages could affect up to 6.4 million prescription items a month in 2026; price concessions hit a record 254 in July and 245 in October (Pharmaceutical Journal). No widespread rationing across major health systems was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Patients on affected medicines may be given an alternative strength or form by their pharmacist under an SSP. The NHS and NHSBSA publish details; anyone unable to get a prescribed medicine should speak to their pharmacist or GP.
rubric_hit: Watch: UK Serious Shortage Protocols for widely used medicines (7 active, NHSBSA); no widespread rationing for Alert
basis_detail: FDA, EMA and NHSBSA shortage lists
basis_by: FDA, EMA and NHSBSA shortage lists

sources.title: Pharmaceutical Journal — NPA urges government action on medicines shortages and pharmacist flexibilities

why: Shipping disruption, factory failures and export curbs can leave essential medicines short, as with US IV fluids after Hurricane Helene in 2024.
drivers: Manufacturing concentrated in India and China, shipping, raw materials, demand spikes, regulation.

rubric.alert: Shortages forcing widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems.
rubric.watch: A shortage of an essential medicine or supply across several countries, or a UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine.
rubric.normal: No widespread shortages of essential medicines in major health systems.
